{{Quote|I've reached her assistant. They're putting us through now.|Natasi Daala's communications officer contacts Cha Niathal's assistant|<ref name="back" />}}
An '''assistant''' served as a personal [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the retired [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] around [[43 ABY]]. In that [[Time/Legends|year]], Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] sent an [[Diplomat/Legends|emissary]], [[Elyas Caran]], to [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to bring Niathal to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be tried for dereliction of duty during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Upon Caran's arrival, the assistant went to inform Niathal that Caran was present, only to find that the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] had committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|When I arrived, her assistant came in to tell her I was present&hellip;and found her in this state.|Elyas Caran, reporting Cha Niathal's death to Natasi Daala|<ref name="back" />}}
An assistant to the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Cha Niathal]] lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] around [[43 ABY]]. [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] after the [[Battle of Uroro Station|conclusion]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Niathal, who had served as an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the war, went into retirement on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Mon Calamari, where the assistant served as Niathal's personal [[Aide/Legends|aide]]. Soon after, as public support declined for Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], Daala was advised by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] to place Niathal on trial for dereliction of duty, to prove that the government was treating military [[Officer/Legends|officers]] the same way they had [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|treated]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had been [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] for the same offense.<ref name="back" />

Daala's [[Unidentified Bothan communications officer|communications officer]] contacted the assistant, who patched them through to Niathal. Daala then informed Niathal of her decision, before sending an [[Diplomat/Legends|emissary]], [[Elyas Caran]], to bring the Mon Calamari to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for her trial. On the Mon Calamari's homeworld, Caran was greeted by Niathal's assistant. The assistant went to inform Niathal that Caran was present, only to find the ex-Admiral [[Death/Legends|dead]] in her [[Water tank (habitat)|water tank]]. They soon discovered that Niathal had run a gas line of [[carbon monoxide]] into her tank, committing suicide in order to avoid the dishonor of her trial. Caran then took Niathal to Coruscant for [[Funeral of Cha Niathal|her funeral]].<ref name="back" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assistant was first mentioned briefly in the fourth installment of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', a [[2010]] novel written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="back" />
